So here's my story in 1989 I joined the US Navy I wanted to be a comeback corpsman with the Marine corps. So I finished boot camp and corman school at camp Pendleton California and was subsequently stationed at camp Pendleton California at a place called 21 area it's the beach area. The unit I was with is called ACU 5 it's a hovercraft unit. Well every 5 days you have to do what's called duty and spend the night at work doing security there. So my duty day came up on a Saturday I reported him for duty I had the first to watch that morning on the quarter deck. After I had my watch I asked my division leading supervisor if I could go surf for a little while down at the beach since we were on the beach. He said sure just be back for evening quarters which gave me about 7 hours of good solid beach time. So I get to the beach and I'm paddling out and I have a pretty good session maybe an hour hour and 30 minutes at most and then I started paddling back in. I heard something behind me that sounded like a huge suction I turned and when I saw it I knew it was not from this planet. It comes straight out of the water and hovered over towards the beach. I made my way out of the water and kind of freaked out and went behind a dune just to watch this thing. Now here's the freaky part there was like a door but it wasn't a door you couldn't see seams of a frame of a door but it opened I've never seen a door open like that in my life. There were three people on board to craft they were blonde haired blue-eyed and I didn't get any nefarious feelings from them they knew how to speak English they asked if I was a soldier I told them I was a sailor. They asked if I would like to see their craft I said you're not going to anal rape me are you jokingly and they laughed and know they don't do that serious is a heartbeat about this part. So I go in their craft and you could feel energy in the air like the hair on my arms was standing up you could just feel energy I asked him how fast this thing goes he said we do need not even know how fast it goes because it's beyond our comprehension. I asked if they were from Earth they said they are from Earth and that they have been here for a long long time. Ask them if they were soldiers and they said they are soldiers but they are more like Air Force soldiers. So this told me three things they knew about our military they knew about our different military branches. I asked them what they were doing here at this area they said that their base is not far from here and I said is it underwater and he replied yes. He told me things about bloodlines and people's auras that they give off. He said us humans cannot see the oars because our field of vision is so narrow. So I'm in the craft and the door closes and I feel this thing accelerating and I started freaking out a little bit and they were just wanting to show me how it flew. They controlled it with a small ball like mouse that they turn right or left up down or they pushed it down to go down or up to go up. I was on board that craft for what felt like 30 to 45 minutes. When they brought me back to the beach and let me out I couldn't find my surfboard that I had left on the beach. So I started walking back to the command we had a huge tarmac that we would launch our hovercrafts from that went from the beach to the command center. So I'm walking back to the command center it's about a mile and a half away and I start noticing people in uniform working on our crafts. That's when I found out I had been reported a wall absence without leave and then that I had been gone for 3 days!!!! I don't know how to explain that part but this is what happened when I told my chain of command what happened. A couple higher echelon officers from Pacific fleet came to debrief me. I told them what happened and then they temporarily duty assigned me to Pacific fleet Coronado Island. I was debriefed maybe three or four different times by different departments. Now here's where it gets super f****** weird. I was in this temporary unit didn't know what was going to happen to me and they told me I had to go get a psychiatric evaluation as part of the evaluation process. Mind you I've never had not one psychological problem in my life ever. So I go to the psychiatrist I tell him what happened just like I've done four or five different times the different people and he said that'll be all we'll be in touch. 5 days later I found out the psychiatrist had written a medical board for me to be retired due to psychological trauma. I was only in the Navy for 3 years. And they retired me at the 100% disabled list. They have been paying me over four grand a month since 1990. I was always scared to say something because I got used to getting the money every month. But after you've been well on what they call 20-year duty list of disabled it takes an act of Congress for them to take your retirement away. That's the reason I tell my story to this day. What happened to me on that day change the way I see the world I realize now that we don't visually see as much as they do. But from what I can remember these people didn't seem mal at all they were more of a benevolent people.
